ns2:section.sectionText: This course meets with BADM 532. All juniors in the Gies College of Business as well as any junior or senior class standing students interested from across campus will need to take part in an application process. You can find the application here: https://business.illinois.edu/subsistence/wp-content/uploads/sites/62/2015/09/Application-form-SPMDSM.pdf.
